title.en-US: Words in Dream of the Red Chamber Chapter Titles

prompt.zh-CN: 填空，各一字：___湘云醉眠芍药裀；___香菱情解石榴裙。
prompt.en-US: Fill in one Chinese character for each blank: ___ Xiangyun sleeps drunk on a peony mat; ___ Xiangling understands the pomegranate skirt.

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是“憨、呆”。这是《红楼梦》回目中的人物称谓。
reveal.en-US: The answers are han and dai. They come from chapter-title wording in Dream of the Red Chamber.

prompt.zh-CN: 填空：我家___有两棵树，一棵是枣树，另一棵也是枣树。
prompt.en-US: Fill the blank in this well-known Chinese meme: In front of my ___ there are two trees; one is a jujube tree, and the other is also a jujube tree.

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是“门前”。这是一句流行改写；鲁迅《秋夜》原文并不是这个完整句式。
reveal.en-US: The answer is men qian, meaning in front of the door. This is a popular rewrite; Lu Xun's original wording in Autumn Night is not exactly this sentence.

title.en-US: Alternate Titles of Dream of the Red Chamber

prompt.zh-CN: 下列哪一个不是《红楼梦》的常见别名或早期题名？
prompt.en-US: Which of the following is not a common alternate or early title of Dream of the Red Chamber?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。《石头记》《金陵十二钗》《风月宝鉴》都和《红楼梦》的题名传统有关。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. The Story of the Stone, The Twelve Beauties of Jinling, and Precious Mirror of Romance are all connected to the title tradition of Dream of the Red Chamber.
